messages:
alice.prod: Hey team — production started returning 401 invalid_api_key right after the last deploy (10:12 UTC). Local curl against the same endpoint works though.

alice.prod: Example curl I ran from the server:```curl -i https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat
  -H "Authorization: Api-Key rk_5a1f..."
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"model":"gpt-4o-mini","input":"hi"}'```

alice.prod: Response body: `{"error":{"type":"invalid_api_key","message":"Authentication failed"}}`

jamie.support: Thanks for the details — quick clarifying q: the token you pasted starts with `rk_`?

alice.prod: yes it starts with rk_ (I grabbed it from the dashboard entry).

jamie.support: That explains it. Dashboard shows a Key ID (rk_...) and the secret value (rsk_...) — only the secret is valid for Authorization. If you use the ID instead of the secret you get a 401.

taylor.eng: to add: the UI lists the ID in a row and the value in a collapsed field when created. It's easy to copy the ID by accident when you're in a hurry/using screenshots. Also the preview/label can look similar.

alice.prod: ohhh — that was it. I rotated a key earlier and copy-pasted the row id. Let me swap to the real secret and test.

alice.prod: ok swapped to the rsk_ value and calls succeed now, latency normal, no 401s. Verified with `curl -i` and app logs. Thanks.

jamie.support: Great — marking this as resolved on our side. We'll add a note to the dashboard docs reminding folks to copy the secret value at creation and not the key id. :thumbsup:

jamie.support: For internal follow-up: can we add a tiny helper text in the key list like "click to reveal value" or a tooltip? @taylor.eng

 taylor.eng: copied to our backlog (ENG-5689) — will propose small UI tweak and a tooltip.

deploy-bot: deploy.prod/score-service v2.14.1 finished at 1719023500 :rocket:

alice.prod: thanks everyone!
